result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Employment Type: Full time - Permanent
Position Classification: Registered Nurse
Remuneration: $1566.70 - $2199.59 Per week
Hours Per Week: 38
Located in: Long Jetty health care Facility
Requisition ID: REQ676600
Application close: Sunday 26th July 2026 at 11.59pm

Do you thrive in a team environment where your expertise makes a real difference? At Central Coast Local Health District (CCLHD), we are committed to Trusted Care, Better Health for Everyone, and we are seeking passionate Registered Nurses to join our Palliative Care Service.

About the Opportunity

As a Registered Nurse in Palliative Care, you will work within a multidisciplinary team to provide specialist, compassionate care to patients and their families. Your role is central to supporting comfort, dignity, and quality of life for individuals with life-limiting conditions. In this role you will:

Deliver high-quality, person-centered palliative care tailored to patient needs.

Undertake assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of nursing interventions.t.

Accurately document healthcare information and maintain electronic patient records.

Collaborate effectively with patients, families, carers, and healthcare team members to ensure continuity of care.

Participate in quality improvement activities, professional development, and service initiatives aligned with CCLHD's strategic goals.

For more information about this role, please view the Position Description

About You

We are looking for someone who has:

Holds current Authority to Practice as a Registered Nurse with AHPRA.

Has a current Australian Driver's Licence, National Criminal Record Check, and Working With Children Check.

Brings extensive clinical experience in Palliative Care and a commitment to evidence-based practice.

Works effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Applicants must have current work rights in Australia or be a permanent resident or citizen. Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants who do not meet this requirement.

Benefits

Work-Life Balance: Enjoy an accrued day off each month, 17.5% annual leave loading, and paid parental leave.

Financial Benefits: Boost your take-home pay with salary packaging, save on car costs with novated leasing, and access relocation assistance.

Health & Wellbeing: Stay active with discounted gym memberships (Fitness Passport), free flu vaccinations, telehealth support, and confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) counselling for you and your family. Plus, access discounted private health insurance.

Career Growth: Advance your career with free professional development courses and secondment opportunities.

Need More Information?

Email: natalie.leadbitter@health.nsw.gov.au

Vaccination Requirements

All NSW Health workers are required to comply with the Occupational Assessment, Screening and Vaccination Against Specified Infectious Diseases Policy Directive. This includes:

Category A positions: Mandatory evidence of protection against specified infectious diseases, including annual influenza vaccination and tuberculosis assessment. 

Applicants must provide appropriate evidence of compliance prior to commencement. For detailed information, please refer to the NSW Health Occupational Assessment, Screening and Vaccination Policy.

NSW Health strongly recommends all workers stay up to date with COVID-19 vaccinations as per the Australian Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation guidelines. However, COVID-19 vaccination is not a condition of employment.
